create_vocabulary_load_from_file: create a Vocabulary object initialized from a text file with one word per line
create_vocabulary_empty: create an empty Vocabulary object without loading from a file
test_vocabulary_index_word: test the Vocabulary index method to look up a word and return its integer index
test_vocabulary_word_index: test the Vocabulary word method to look up an index and return its word string
build_vocabulary_decode_tensor: build a call to get_tensor_string to decode a tensor into a space-separated word string
